text: Source work adds optional explicit checked registry to science/document, exact scope validation, inherited existing-draft ownership and atomic SaveAndRun ownership extension. Freshness compares only same-family runs/drafts while jobs and DatasetMoved remain project-wide. Astra design audit identified bundle decomposition and native storage projection; both now preserve ownership, bundle uses immutable optional family part plus conditional manifest version3. No new journal payload is introduced in this slice; base document and science checkpoint bind ownership. Tests drafted for interleaving, preservation/undo/replay, codecs and bundle sharing/corruption. No builds until data/trials resource release; document/science schema rung numbers remain unallocated pending its qualified landing.
